integrity: All included finite certificates are complete standalone source files; exact computations were executed from the packaged scripts. All-length statements have explicit combinatorial proofs. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to binary words of Hamming weight exactly two in cyclic symbol-pair distance at least seven; the full classification is for even fully supported extremizers and the 22-code count is for length ten only. General bound constructions and Euler methodology have prior art. The 2025 constant-pair-weight distance-seven paper was not fully accessible; possible overlap remains.
